decision_contract.prepared_or_derived_ready: reuse kernel allocation, including role derivation, capability checks, active claims, authority class and live write-collision filtering
decision_contract.recovery: eligible retry-safe recovery candidates compete by the same weighted opportunity score plus bounded age urgency; selected recovery always requires APPEND_ONLY_RECOVERY_CLAIM
decision_contract.context_compile_fallback: allowed only with context_compile_required + context_compile_authorized and only after prepared/recovery frontiers are empty
decision_contract.compact_fallback: allowed only with compact_required + compact_authorized and only after prepared/recovery frontiers are empty
decision_contract.discovery_fallback: allowed only with discovery_authorized and only after prepared/recovery/context/compact frontiers are empty
decision_contract.idle: IDLE_NO_SAFE_USEFUL_WORK is emitted only when discovery_recovery_exhausted is explicitly true
decision_contract.authority: allocator emits candidate/scoped decisions only and cannot promote Current, Human Accepted or Served

coverage: highest-value prepared selection and role derivation
eligible recovery can preempt lower-value work
